svg.aria-label: Arena factory map. An idea is framed and specified, the human signs off, it is sliced into tracer-bullet tickets, the human approves the breakdown, each ticket runs a round of TDD, proof, three review lenses, a PR, CI and answered review threads until the human merges, then the season is integrated, released, approved, shipped, baked and its value validated, and the retro feeds lessons back into the factory. Beads holds every step, ticket, gate and event.
